q: The Leray-Hirsch theorem gives conditions for the cohomology of a fiber bundle E → B with fiber F to split as H*(E) ≅ H*(B) ⊗ H*(F). The conditions are:
opts: The inclusion of each fiber F → E_b induces a surjection H*(E) → H*(F), and H*(F) is a free module
exp: Leray-Hirsch: if i*: H*(E) → H*(F) is surjective (equivalently, there exist global cohomology classes on E restricting to a basis for each fiber), then H*(E) ≅ H*(B) ⊗ H*(F) as H*(B)-modules. This applies to sphere bundles, flag bundles, etc.
